newsitems.title: The Masks We Wear: Phase 3 is here!（5★ Phantom Thief Cosmic Yu）
newsitems.author: toshiyuki.sasaki
newsitems.contents:
[h2]Content[/h2][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45621326/e64a58e13e775bf2b99abec1befa293bcea6aa1a.png"][/img][/p][h3]• Main Story Chapter 4: The Masks We Wear: Phase 3 is here![/h3][p]The following content has been added alongside the release of the latest part of the Main Story.[/p][p]　Content added:[/p][p]　┗ Palaces: New Areas[/p][p]　┗ Mementos: New Areas[/p][p]　▽ The Masks We Wear: Phase 3 Release Event[/p][p]　Duration: Until Oct 15, 2026 at 1:59 AM (UTC)[/p][p][/p][h3][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45621326/95a4d0777ab6978846413ef7be2a1cedaa5329e3.png"][/img]• 5★ Phantom Thief Cosmic Yui comes to Most Wanted Phantom Idol Contracts! [/h3][p]Duration: Until Oct 15, 2026 at 1:59 AM (UTC)[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45621326/df2be42e8a4d9a7e2f894e93cceb407c1384296f.png"][/img][/p][h3]• Event: Harvest World: Cosmic Calamity[/h3][p]Duration: Until Oct 15, 2026 at 1:59 AM (UTC)[/p][p]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45621326/8d038b29b518e9ec7278b9f849833825759639c8.png"][/img][/p][h3]• Event: Shadow Hunt[/h3][p]Duration: Until Oct 15, 2026 at 1:59 AM (UTC)[/p][p]You can view a list of the Strong Enemies in the new Palace and Mementos areas from the event page.[/p][p]In Mementos, you can also unlock Path of Kaitul even if you have not yet reached all preceding areas.
[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45621326/d3d62eaec431652a153a6c42635a18efd97af7aa.png"][/img][/p][h3]• P3R Special Event Completion Missions[/h3][p]Complete special missions to earn Gold Tickets.
 [/p][h3]• Login Bonus[/h3][p]Duration: Until Sep 23, 2026 at 9:59 PM (UTC)[/p][p]Log in for 7 days during the event period to receive a total of 7 Platinum Tickets![/p][h3]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45621326/21e5b489c40777fef9b308c0d859e32feeaee762.png"][/img]• "Dissected by Kira Kitazato?!" ASMR Release Celebration Gift[/h3][p]Claim by: Jun 26, 2027 at 2:59 PM (UTC)[/p][p]To celebrate the release of "Dissected by Kira Kitazato?!," an ASMR production created as Kira Kitazato's reward for taking first place in the P5X 1st Anniversary Popularity Poll, we are sending all players a special gift.
 [/p][h3]• Thieves Den Feature Expansion[/h3][p]The maximum Den Level will be raised from 60 to 70.[/p][p]Items and music related to P3R will also be added.
[/p][h3]• New Stages Added to The Velvet Trials[/h3][p]Stages 26-30 will be added to the following areas in The Velvet Trials.[/p][p]　▽ New Stages:[/p][p]　└ Lair of Arcane Flame[/p][p]　└ Nuclear Winter[/p][p]　└ Thunderous Blessing[/p][p]　└ An Ill Wind[/p][p]Meta Jewel rewards will also be added for the cumulative number of ★ earned across the four newly added areas.[/p][p]*Stardust Shard rewards will not be added.
[/p][h3]• New Additions to the Joy Medal Exchange[/h3][p]The Wonder-exclusive weapon Event Horizon and Event Horizon Shards, the special crystals used to forge it, will be added to the Joy Medal Exchange.
[/p][h3]• New Additions to the Repression Medal Exchange[/h3][p]The following Skill Cards will be added to the Repression Medal IV Exchange.[/p][p]　▽ New Items:[/p][p]　└ Cohesion[/p][p]　└ Accuracy Boost V[/p][p]　└ Marakunda[/p][p]　└ Phys Boost V[/p][p]　└ Attack Boost V[/p][p]　└ Battle Acumen V
[/p][h3]• New Additions to the Salamander Coin Exchange[/h3][p]Artisan's Mod Orders, which can be used to forge 5★ weapons, and select limited 5★ weapons, including Ren Amamiya's exclusive weapon, will be added to the Salamander Coin Exchange at the Airsoft Shop in Shibuya.[/p][p]*Artisan's Mod Orders and each limited 5★ weapon require 20 Salamander Coins.
[/p][h3]• New Space Revelation Cards[/h3][p]Acuity will be added to the exchange lineup for items that grant Space Revelation Cards, such as Orange Fortune Revelation and Unknown Orange Revelation S. 
[/p][h3]• New Sun, Moon, Star, and Sky Revelation Cards[/h3][p]Satiety and Gain will be added to the exchange lineup for items that grant Sun, Moon, Star, and Sky Revelation Cards, such as Fortune Revelation and Unknown Orange Revelation.
[/p][h3]• New Revelation Cards Available for Inscription[/h3][p]The following Revelation Cards will be added as options for Inscription.[/p][p]　▽ New Cards:[/p][p]　└ Space: Hope[/p][p]　└ Sun, Moon, Star, Sky: Prudence and Ruin
[/p][h3]• Realm of Repression Update[/h3][p]　▽ New:[/p][p]　└ Revelation Cards Added: Satiety & Gain
[/p][h3]• New Additions to the Tycoon Points Exchange[/h3][p]　▽ New Items:[/p][p]　└ Miyu's Invite[/p][p]　└ Ayaka's Invite[/p][p]　└ Minami ♥5[/p][p]　└ Merope ♦2[/p][p]　└ Miyu ♦5
[/p][h3][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45621326/1560b8c22080a34c9420f428d61ff015ed1477dd.png"][/img]• New Limited-Time Plushies in the Crane Game![/h3][p]Available Until: Until Nov 12, 2026 at 1:59 AM (UTC)[/p][p]　▽ New Plushies:[/p][p]　└ Harvest World Wonder[/p][p]　└ Mini Harvest World Yui[/p][p]*Also available from the Prize Counter, under the Crane Game menu.[/p][p]*Lamia and Mini Narcissus plushies will be available until maintenance begins on Sep 9, 2026.
[/p][h3]• New Synergy Story Unlocked[/h3][p]　▽ New Side Story:[/p][p]　└ (Added) Musubi Matsukata
[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45621326/418d80daff27ad0d1bdbe45815b2d1da77f154b7.png"][/img][/p][h3]• Phantom Pass Update[/h3][p]Season Duration: Until Oct 29, 2026 at 1:59 AM (UTC)[/p][p]Complete the new seasonal missions to earn rewards.[/p][p]*The EXP and level of the currently active pass will be reset when the season changes at 1:59 AM on Sep 9, 2026 (UTC).
[/p][p]*Important Notes*[/p][p]• The event content and schedule are subject to change without prior notice.[/p]

newsitems.contents:
[h2]Event Content[/h2][h3][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45621326/a893326e51fd2877112ebf3309683c9250bc98fa.png"][/img]・Tour de Force Sports Fest Event[/h3][p]Duration: Until Sep 9, 2026 at 1:59 AM (UTC)[/p][p]*More details will be shared in a future announcement.[/p][p]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45621326/650e81c4c281765ae2a4c5010965e5c97a7dc1c9.png"][/img][/p][h3]• 5★ Phantom Thief Kumi Katayama comes to Most Wanted Phantom Idol Contracts![/h3][p]Duration: Until Sep 24, 2026 at 1:59 AM (UTC)[/p][p]*More details will be shared in a future announcement.
[/p][h3]• Login Bonus[/h3][p]Duration: Until Sep 9, 2026 at 1:59 AM (UTC)[/p][p]Log in for 7 days during the event period to earn up to 7 Platinum Milicoins![/p][p]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45621326/961e277ce03916a3d0658336780b853284c11882.png"][/img][/p][h3]• Mark and Favorites features for Mail[/h3][p]You can now Mark or Favorite your mail while reading its contents.[/p][p]Marking mail exempts it from deletion when selecting Delete All Claimed.[/p][p]Unmark the mail to return it to normal.[/p][p]Please note that marked mail can still be deleted individually by clicking the Delete button.[/p][p]When mail is favorited, it is moved to the Normal section of your Saved Mail.[/p][p]You can delete Saved Mail individually.[/p][p]*Mail that was already saved as Saved Mail prior to this update will be moved to the Saved Mail > Special.[/p][p]*Mail with attachments can be favorited after the items have been claimed.[/p][p]*Mail that was moved to Favorites cannot be moved to the original mailbox.
[/p][h3][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45621326/8bedd3690c1dddda1505551cab6c4f3a37176dab.png"][/img]
• New Bonds[/h3][p]Duration: Until Sep 24, 2026 at 1:59 AM (UTC)[/p][p]　▽ New Side Story:[/p][p]　┗ Musubi Matsukata
[/p][h3]• New Synergy Stories unlocked[/h3][p]　▽ New Side Story:[/p][p]　┗ Kumi Katayama
[/p][p]*Important Notes*[/p][p]• The event content and duration are subject to change without prior notice.[/p]

• Main Story Chapter 4: The Masks We Wear: Phase 2 is here![/h3][p]The following content has been added alongside the release of the latest part of the Main Story.[/p][p]　Content added:[/p][p]　┗ Palaces: New Areas[/p][p]　┗ Mementos: New Areas[/p][p]　▽ The Masks We Wear: Phase 2 Release Event[/p][p]　Duration: Until Sep 9, 2026 at 1:59 AM (UTC)[/p][p]　*More details will be shared in a future announcement.

newsitems.title: Ver. 4.6 Update Information（5★ Phantom Thief: Wavecatcher Miyu）
newsitems.author: toshiyuki.sasaki
newsitems.contents:
[h3]Event Content
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45621326/69c4060ef04884e533aff5f78964d90f5e142f92.png"][/img]• Event: Haunted Beach Shack: Menacing Maw from the Murky Marine[/h3][p]Duration: Until 1:59 AM Aug 13, 2026 (UTC)[/p][p]*More details will be shared in a future announcement.
[/p][h3][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45621326/676d1742cc97fcdddb7a5405799ced7ff0213ecc.png"][/img]
• 5★ Phantom Thief: Wavecatcher Miyu is coming to Most Wanted Phantom Idol Contracts![/h3][p]Duration: Until 1:59 AM Aug 13, 2026 (UTC)[/p][p]*More details will be shared in a future announcement.
[/p][h3]• Event: Bonus in a Bottle[/h3][p]Duration: Until 1:59 AM Aug 13, 2026 (UTC)[/p][p]During the event, you can choose to receive one reward each from a Seashell Bottle and a Pearl Bottle.[/p][p]The Seashell Bottle will reward you with a set of gifts including items related to Revelations.[/p][p]The Pearl Bottle will reward you with items you can use for Contracts.[/p][p]*Check in-game for more details.
[/p][h3]• Login Bonus[/h3][p]Duration: Until 1:59 AM Aug 13, 2026 (UTC)[/p][p]Log in for 6 days during the event period to earn up to 7 Platinum Milicoins![/p][p]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45621326/961e277ce03916a3d0658336780b853284c11882.png"][/img][/p][h3]• Removal of Unlock Conditions for the Realm of Repression[/h3][p]Under the Training Materials menu, the requirements to unlock Shadows in Recollections will be removed, and you will be able to opt to unlock them even if you haven't finished the corresponding Main Story section.[/p][h3]
• New feature added to Gates of the Nightmare Catcher[/h3][p]A new Life Sustainment feature has been added to Devourer of Dreams in Gates of the Nightmare Catcher.[/p][p]When Life Sustainment is turned on, the boss's HP will not fall below 1%.[/p][p]Life Sustainment settings can be freely switched on and off during any player turn (as long as Auto-Battle is turned off). You can use this to help control when you apply Weakened to a boss.
[/p][h3]• New Item: Crystal Cognigem[/h3][p]Once you have drawn the same 5★ Phantom Thief 8 times, you can now receive Crystal Cognigems as specified below.[/p][p]*A 5★ Phantom Thief's Cognitite also counts toward this total.[/p][p]You can exchange Crystal Cognigems for valuable rewards at the Exchange Shop.[/p][p]▽ For 5★ Phantom Thieves available in Phantom Idol Draft X:[/p][p]└ For every time drawn after the 7th, receive Crystal Cognigems x4[/p][p]▽ For 5★ Phantom Thieves not available in Phantom Idol Draft X:[/p][p]└ For every time drawn after the 7th, receive Crystal Cognigems x10[/p][p]• Crystal Cognigems for Users who have Already Drawn the Same 5★ Phantom Thief 8+ times[/p][p]With the addition of this new item, following the maintenance on Jul 30, 2026, we will begin distributing Crystal Cognigems to users who already have the qualifying number of 5★ Phantom Thieves via the in-game Mail.[/p][p]*Please note that we may require up to 10 days to process distributions.[/p][p]Eligible Users:[/p][p]Players who have drawn the same 5★ Phantom Thief 8 times or more prior to the beginning of maintenance on Jul 30, 2026.[/p][p]*A 5★ Phantom Thief's Cognitite also counts toward this total.[/p][p]Distribution Details:[/p][p]Players will receive Crystal Cognigems for each time they have drawn the same 5★ Phantom Thief beyond the 7th time.[/p][p]Please refer to "New Item: Crystal Cognigem" above for details on the amount of Crystal Cognigems earned per draw.[/p][p]*If qualifying for Crystal Cognigems from both Draft X and non-Draft X Thieves, you will receive the sum of both.[/p][p]*Distribution amounts will be calculated based on Phantom Idol Draft X records as of Jul 30, 2026.
[/p][h3]• New additions to the Cognition Shop[/h3][p]Crystal Cognigems have been added to the Cognigem Exchange Shop.[/p][p]Crystal Cognigems can be exchanged for valuable rewards like Thief's Cognitite Shards, Elysian Ink or other Inks usable for customization, plus Orange Fortune Revelations, Everlasting Incense, and more.[/p][p]Elysian Ink and Prophetic Ink have also been added to the lineup for exchanging Prism Cognigems.[/p][p]*Check in-game for more details.
[/p][h3]• New Additions to the Joy Medal Exchange[/h3][p]Added the Wonder-exclusive weapon Ice Age and Ice Age Shards, the special crystals used to forge it, to the Joy Medal Exchange.
[/p][h3]• Notice: Salamander Coin Exchange Lineup Scheduling[/h3][p]The addition of Limited 5★ Weapons and Artisan's Mod Orders to the lineup of items you can exchange Salamander Coins for, as announced during Persona X-Stream Ver. 4.5 & 4.6, has been rescheduled to a later update in September.[/p][p]There will be no additions to the lineup for Salamander Coins in Ver. 4.6. We appreciate your understanding.
[/p][h3]• New Additions to the Tycoon Points Exchange[/h3][p]　▽ New Items:[/p][p]　└ Yukimi's Invite[/p][p]　└ Shiratori's Invite[/p][p]　└ Igor ♠2[/p][p]　└ Yui ♦9[/p][p]　└ Haruna ♦10
[/p][h3][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45621326/ca822dc6ae9032b0afe4c8f6cfe48b13f1dd1579.png"][/img]
• Limited-Time Maid for the Beach Capsule Toys in Akihabara![/h3][p]Duration: Until Sep 24, 2026 at 1:59 AM (UTC)[/p][p]Fill your Display Case with these limited-time capsule toys to enjoy your collection of bikini maids anytime!
[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45621326/48885c9785f10ae413abc58ad6cb3877a173a9fd.png"][/img][/p][h3]• New Bonds[/h3][p]Duration: Until 1:59 AM Aug 27, 2026 (UTC)[/p][p]　▽ New Side Story:[/p][p]　┗ Ichigo Shikano
[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45621326/a984f82097ed8189cf3e9e12e71652b469175533.png"][/img][/p][h3]• Phantom Pass Update[/h3][p]Season Duration: Until 1:59 AM Sep 9, 2026 (UTC)[/p][p]Complete the new seasonal missions to earn rewards.[/p][p]*The EXP and level of the currently active pass will be reset when the season changes at 1:59 AM on Jul 30, 2026 (UTC).
[/p][p]*Important Notes*[/p][p]• The event content and duration are subject to change without prior notice.[/p]
